description: Gecko checks an agent's API call or Solana transaction against the real surface before it counts: first-call-correct MCP tools from any OpenAPI or program, unsigned checked bytes for money paths, and refusals that say why.
rules: gecko-surf is the API comprehension layer for agents: it turns an OpenAPI or a Solana program into first-call-correct MCP tools. It is never a payment rail or a marketplace.
Gecko is the control plane, never the data plane: it stores the API surface and correctness metadata, never response payloads, user data, or secrets.
Onboard any API with `gecko add <api>`; serve one over MCP with `gecko <openapi-url>`; verify doc claims against reality with `gecko verify-docs <spec>`.
Gecko composes on top of OpenAPI (input), MCP (transport) and Context7 (a docs input). It does not replace them.
Gecko never holds a key and never signs: every money path ends in unsigned, simulation-checked bytes plus a receipt, and the user's own wallet signs.

Gecko treats every ingested API surface (specs, docs, tool descriptions, images) as untrusted input and quarantines prompt injection or tool poisoning before the agent reads it; auth is injected at call time so the agent never holds API keys.
